id: \bNoland: Welcome to the Battle Factory. My name is Noland and I will be your challenger.
en: \bNoland: Welcome to the Battle Factory. My name is Noland and I will be your challenger.
it: \bNoland: Benvenuto all'Fabbrica Lotta. Mi chiamo Noland e sarò il tuo sfidante.

id: \bNormally, I would require you to use a Rental Pokémon to battle against me.
en: \bNormally, I would require you to use a Rental Pokémon to battle against me.
it: \bDi norma ti chiederei di usare dei Pokémon a noleggio per lottare contro di me.

id: \bHowever, I see that you have gathered not only all the badges from Kanto but Hoenn as well. I want to see the power you possess.
en: \bHowever, I see that you have gathered not only all the badges from Kanto but Hoenn as well. I want to see the power you possess.
it: \bTuttavia, vedo che hai raccolto non solo tutte le medaglie di Kanto, ma anche quelle di Hoenn. Voglio vedere il potere che possiedi.
\bNoland: Ti sei meritato il Simbolo Sapere.

id: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Arena. It's located near Saffron City.
en: \bI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Arena. It's located near Saffron City.
it: \bTi consiglio di andare al Dojo Lotta come prossima tappa. Si trova vicino a Zafferanopoli.
